@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import sys

+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, MutableMapping

 from typing import Any
 
 import anyio
@@ -7,7 +8,8 @@ import pytest
 from anyio.abc import ObjectReceiveStream, ObjectSendStream
 
 from starlette import status
-from starlette.responses import Response
+from starlette.background import BackgroundTask
+from starlette.responses import FileResponse, Response, StreamingResponse
 from starlette.testclient import WebSocketDenialResponse
 from starlette.types import Message, Receive, Scope, Send
 from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketState
@@ -322,6 +324,57 @@ def test_send_denial_response(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
     assert exc.value.content == b"foo"
 
 
+def test_send_denial_streaming_response(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    background_calls = 0
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        nonlocal background_calls
+
+        async def stream() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+            yield b"streamed"
+            yield b" body"
+
+        async def background() -> None:
+            nonlocal background_calls
+            background_calls += 1
+
+        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+        await websocket.receive()
+        response = StreamingResponse(
+            stream(),
+            status_code=404,
+            background=BackgroundTask(background),
+        )
+        await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDenialResponse) as exc:
+        with client.websocket_connect("/"):
+            pass  # pragma: no cover
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 404
+    assert exc.value.content == b"streamed body"
+    assert background_calls == 1
+
+
+def test_send_denial_file_response(tmp_path: Path, test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "denied.txt"
+    path.write_bytes(b"file body")
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        scope["extensions"]["http.response.pathsend"] = {}
+        websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+        await websocket.receive()
+        response = FileResponse(path, status_code=401)
+        await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDenialResponse) as exc:
+        with client.websocket_connect("/"):
+            pass  # pragma: no cover
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 401
+    assert exc.value.content == b"file body"
+
+
 def test_send_response_multi(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:

         websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
